title: 第2章 榜下求婿，她亦重生

In the first year of Chongsheng, winter has gone for a long time, but the cold is not over yet.

Chunwei is about to release the results.

The whole city was awakened by the pressure of this tense atmosphere.

The streets, teahouses and restaurants were crowded with Gongsheng students and their families who came to see the results and other news.

Everywhere there are people who hope that they or their students will become talented, with fame and fame in their eyes.

Even the air is filled with an aura of anxiety that awaits high school.

The three young men sat in the small restaurant for a long time and drank two bottles of wine.

Pei Zhang thought the wine was bad, so he asked the store owner to serve him a better one.

Yang Kaiji complained that he was from a noble family and was picky.

Gu Chen sat aside and listened to their bickering. The corners of his mouth were slightly raised, but his heart was filled with waves that could not be seen by others.

He has confirmed that he is back.

In the first year of Chongsheng, after the Spring Festival and before the release of the list.

Speaking of Yang Kaiji and Pei Zhang, he and these two are really a coincidence.

When we met in Gongyuan, no one recognized anyone else.

Yang Kaiji was born into a poor family, and his ancestors had been prosperous in previous generations.He was raised by a widowed mother. He was born with a face like a crown jewel. He was proud of his talent and always quoted scriptures in his conversations, which shocked everyone in the audience.

Pei Zhang came from a branch of the Pei family in Jingzhao. Although he was a nobleman, he hated the distinction of family status. His conversation was humorous and he claimed to be good at arithmetic and deliberation.

The two men were handsome in appearance, and someone recognized them immediately.

One is Yang Kaiji and Yang Boyuan, a famous talent in Lingzhou. His poems and articles are unparalleled, and people at the time said he was "the most talented in the world."

One is Pei Zhang and Pei Jinggui, a well-known prodigal son in the capital. He once helped the Jingzhao Yin Mansion solve a strange case by relying on deliberation.

For a time, countless Gongsheng students came to curry favor with him.

As for Gu Chen, he was an orphan born as a refugee. He looked ordinary, but his features were handsome and somewhat delicate. If you look closely, he was not much inferior to Yang Kaiji and Yang Kaiji.It just lacked a bit of uniqueness after all, and I forgot about it after seeing it.

But as soon as he opened his mouth, he knew everything from the art of war to farming, from celestial phenomena to classics and history.

Yang Kaiji asked him who he studied under, and he only said "self-taught".

Can self-study reach this point?Neither of them believed it, but they didn't ask any more questions.I just felt that Gu Chen had a ridge in his chest, which was definitely not something in the pool.

Later, Yang Kaiji and Pei Zhang came to stop Gu Chen at the same time and wanted to talk. The three of them sat in the corridor of the Gongyuan and talked for half a day.

From the way of governing the country to the current situation, the more we talk about it, the more speculative it becomes, and it seems that we regret meeting each other too late.

Although the three of them have their own views on family and country, and they often have conflicts when discussing Taoism, they still maintain the gentlemanly style and are harmonious but different.

When they were leaving, Pei Zhang took the hands of the two of them and said: "I have never looked at family status. Regardless of whether you pass or fail in this subject, I, Pei Zhang, have decided to make you two friends."

Yang Kaiji and Gu Chen nodded in agreement.

Just as I was thinking about it, there was a sudden commotion outside.

"The results are released! The results are released!"

The whole street seemed to have exploded.

The diners threw down their chopsticks and rushed outside. The waiter was knocked staggering and cursed a few words, but he couldn't help but tiptoe to look outside.

The three of them looked at each other, put down their wine glasses, and followed the crowd outside.
